provenance.notes: Pinout, dimensions and ratings: Kingbright CA56-12EWA (0.56 in four digit, common anode, right-hand decimal; spec DSAP8253 rev V.1A), page 1 package drawing and internal circuit: digit commons Dig1 = 12, Dig2 = 9, Dig3 = 8, Dig4 = 6; segments a = 11, b = 7, c = 4, d = 2, e = 1, f = 10, g = 5, DP = 3 (shared by all four digits); body 50.3 x 19 x 8.1 mm, digit pitch 12.7 mm, 15.24 mm between pin rows (6 pitches), 2.54 mm pin pitch, 0.5 mm leads 4 mm long. Ratings (page 2): VF 1.9 V typical and 2.3 V maximum at 10 mA, DC IF 30 mA, peak 160 mA at 1/10 duty and 0.1 ms, VR 5 V. Numbering is counter-clockwise from pin 1 at the bottom left of the top view (pins 1 to 6 along the bottom, 7 to 12 back along the top, so pin 12 sits above pin 1). Because the digits are multiplexed, the per-segment duty is 1/4 or less in use. SunFounder's Vincent kit page for its 4-digit display states common anode and draws the same pin numbering (a = 11, b = 7, c = 4, d = 2, e = 1, f = 10, g = 5, dp = 3, D1 = 12, D2 = 9, D3 = 8, D4 = 6), so the Kingbright datasheet matches the SunFounder part. Kingbright's common-cathode CC56-12EWA has identical pin numbers with every LED reversed, and this definition models only the common-anode version; other 12-pin four-digit modules exist in both polarities, so check the marking of a physical module. Not in the SunFounder Basic Starter Kit for Raspberry Pi: its component-list image shows no 4-digit display. The SunFounder part's own manufacturer and marking were not found. VF and current ratings are for Kingbright's high-efficiency-red chip.
